name: Peirui Liu
statement: I am an undergraduate student in Computer Science at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. I am interested in efficient language model inference and the systems that support it, with a broader interest in computer systems and architecture.

manuscripts.title: Research in progress
manuscripts.authors: Peirui Liu, Jiacheng Liu, Wenfeng Wang, Xiaofeng Hou
manuscripts.summary: Ongoing work on inference methods and systems for large language models. Further details will be shared when appropriate.

projects.name: CS336
projects.summary: My self-study implementations and notes for Stanford CS336, from tokenization and Transformers to GPU systems, data processing, and alignment. Includes Stanford starter code and course materials.
projects.status: Main track completed; some large-scale GPU experiments were not run.

projects.name: YMarkdownG
projects.summary: A desktop Markdown editor with visual, source, split-preview, and reading modes. The repository implements local file editing, image paste, math rendering, and PDF export.
projects.status: v0.6 series; Windows tested, macOS/Linux built in CI. Packages are unsigned.

projects.name: NanTangJieYu-V
projects.summary: An interactive system for a campus fan event: player registration, region progression, contribution ledgers, administrator controls, and weighted prize draws. Includes a mobile player interface and projection display.
projects.status: Implemented with unit and integration tests; designed for approximately 150 participants.

projects.name: SJTU-empty-Classroom-Radar
projects.summary: A classroom availability tool combining timetable queries with real-time room data. The public implementation includes building selection, time-range queries, and a web interface.
projects.status: Public implementation available; live-service availability depends on upstream data.

projects.name: SJTUHPC2026
projects.summary: My preparation repository for SJTU HPC 2026, containing study materials and programming exercises, including shell scripts and C/C++ build-system practice.
projects.status: Training snapshot; no benchmark or competition result claimed.

projects.name: MiniVim
projects.summary: A fork of the SJTUJohnClass MiniVim course project. Kept here as a coursework reference; the upstream editor and specification are not claimed as my original work.
projects.status: Personal implementation scope has not been independently established.
